title: Ultron
tagline: A Discord bot and dashboard that turns community operations, pull requests and deploys into one clear story.
stateNote: The dashboard is live: sign in with Discord. The bot worker runs on Northflank, and the data lives on Neon. Built for Mo's Lab, the owner's private builder server.
problem: Running a Discord community usually means stacking several single-purpose bots, while build, pull request and deploy noise lives somewhere else. Ultron puts moderation, support, events and what actually shipped into one workspace, and tells short stories about the work instead of dumping raw logs.
audience: Server owners and small teams who want calmer Discord operations, and builders who want their GitHub and Vercel activity to show up as readable progress.
contribution: It is my project: a Discord gateway bot and a Next.js dashboard that share a database, so the web app never holds the bot token. I built it for Mo's Lab. The dashboard is hosted on Vercel and opens with Discord login. The bot worker runs on Northflank, and Postgres is on Neon. I am not publishing a public server invite.
worksToday: Guided setup, explainable moderation with a review queue, onboarding and roles, support tickets, and events with RSVP.
An append-only audit log for people, the bot and optional AI, kept in a staff-only area of the dashboard.
ShipPulse turns signed GitHub and Vercel events into one evolving story per pull request, once those webhooks are connected.
Project Constellation maps projects as stars you can inspect, with builds, deploys and incidents in orbit.
Ship Questlines awards achievements for verified shipped work, such as a first pull request or a first production deploy, not for time spent chatting.
The Forge can turn a milestone into a collectible card or sticker. /council is an AI design review. Incident Time Machine replays a failed deploy.
Optional AI can draft channel summaries and help triage reports. It is advisory: a human approves every consequential moderation action.
The dashboard is hosted on Vercel and opens with Discord login. The bot worker runs on Northflank, and the database is Postgres on Neon.
limitations: The live dashboard requires a Discord login, and it is built for Mo's Lab, so it is not a walk-in public demo.
The screenshots are from a development run that uses synthetic project data (labelled as such in the interface), not from the current production deployment.
ShipPulse cannot tell live build stories until a project has signed GitHub and Vercel webhooks.
This page is written from my description of the build and those screenshots, not from a public repository.

involve.headline: Running a Discord server, or shipping a lot of side projects?
asks: If a calmer ops bot or a clearer view of what shipped would help your community, tell me.
If you have a Questline or Forge idea that should exist, I want to hear it.

disclosure.note: The owner asked on 2026-11-17 to feature Ultron and Mo's Lab on the homepage, and later asked for the live dashboard link to be added. The source repository is private and is not linked. This page is written from those requests, the owner's description of the build, dashboard screenshots taken for this site, and the hosted dashboard linked here.

approach: Replaced a stack of single-purpose Discord bots with one guided workspace for setup, moderation, onboarding, tickets and events.
Split the Next.js dashboard and the Discord worker so they share a database, and so the bot token never lives in the web app.
Added build intelligence on top of that: signed deploy stories, a constellation map of projects, quests for real shipped work, and milestone cards.

decisions.choice: AI is advisory, never in charge
decisions.why: Optional AI can draft summaries and help triage reports, but a human approves every consequential moderation action.

decisions.choice: Host the dashboard, the worker and the database separately
decisions.why: The dashboard is live on Vercel with Discord login. The bot worker runs on Northflank, and Postgres is on Neon, so the web app never holds the bot token.

caseStudy.outcome: Ultron is the first project in Selected work on this site. The dashboard is live on Vercel, the bot worker is hosted on Northflank, and the database is Postgres on Neon.
